temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. During their conversation, Gary declines the weekend retreat because he has too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is dedicated but dangerously overworked and in need of rest and a healthier routine.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's refusal confirms that his hospital obligations are currently preventing him from accepting a break, so Ethan's concern remains unresolved.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is still overworked and either unable or unwilling to step away from work right now, so he needs continued support and concern.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue trying to help Gary prioritize his health and find some way to rest or reduce his workload.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes Gary's restless behavior and avoidance of discussions about work. After Ethan confronts him, Gary says it's complicated and that he didn't want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary's overwork is mainly caused by professional obligations at the hospital, though he remains deeply concerned.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's restlessness and avoidance, along with his vague response, make Ethan suspect the overwork is not just professional but has deeper personal or emotional causes.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is likely dealing with something more complicated than ordinary work stress and is reluctant to share it because he does not want to burden others.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Gently confront Gary, encourage him to open up, and offer nonjudgmental support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Gary also accepts Ethan's suggestion to prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspects Gary's overwork has deeper personal causes and wants Gary to feel safe enough to share them.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary reveals the specific work and personal pressures behind his behavior and shows willingness to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overwhelmed by both professional and personal challenges, but he is open to practical support and can work toward a better balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule so he can make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in and sees Gary making efforts to change. Gary reports feeling less overwhelmed and even having time for a movie.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is willing to improve but still faces challenges and benefits from ongoing support and encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's reported progress and visible efforts show that the support is helping and that meaningful improvement is occurring.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making genuine progress toward a healthier work-life balance and is becoming less overwhelmed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular check-ins, offer encouragement, and remain available whenever Gary needs to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary thanks Ethan, says he feels more in control, and Ethan sees that Gary can manage on his own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is improving and still benefits from support and encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's sustained adjustment and increased sense of control show that he can now manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has achieved a healthier balance and is capable of maintaining it on his own, so Ethan can step back while staying available.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Step back and let Gary manage independently, while remaining available if Gary ever needs support.
